**Subject: Launch position and next step**

Hi Avery,

The launch tentatively scheduled for October 8, 2026 cannot proceed as a production release on that date. The security review now completes October 12 at the earliest, and release requires completed approval. Nia owns the review, which may require remediation; no new production date is authorized.

We can still hold a staging demo on October 8 using synthetic data, without changing the requirement for completed approval before release.

I remain confident in the team and in Nia’s ownership of the security review. We will continue to treat release approval as essential and will not assume a new production date while the review outcome remains uncertain.

Please confirm whether you accept the October 8 staging demo using synthetic data so we can proceed accordingly.

Best,  
Jordan  
Engagement Lead
